summary: Improve receivables prioritization, dispute handling and collection controls. Explore the five-day course and practical account exercises.
lede: Revenue collection strategies use account data and structured follow-up to prioritize overdue balances and resolve payment issues. For receivables and credit professionals, this course develops skills in aging and DSO analysis, account segmentation, customer contact planning, dispute escalation and payment reconciliation. Exercises use a sample ledger and practical scenarios to build collection dashboards, dispute workflows and control checklists; coverage of IFRS 9, PCI DSS and ISO 10002 is introductory.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who handle customer balances, collection decisions, payment exceptions or receivables controls. It starts at foundation level and builds toward structured collection planning.
modules: DSO, Roll Rates and Account Segmentation
COSO Controls and PCI DSS Safeguards
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with invoicing, customer account records or credit control is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed for the workbook exercises.
